status: frozen after the v19G astrometric gate passed and before any registered science-image inspection, merged image construction, edge search, spectrum extraction, temperature or density fit, projection draw, causal-source construction, replacement-cluster lensing access, or gravity fit
purpose: Measure source-side gas morphology, merger fronts, thermodynamic state, member phase structure, and assembly-clock uncertainty for the Bullet Cluster and Abell 2146 under one target-blind protocol.

sample.role: mechanism-development pair selected using source observability only

registered_inputs.science_events: the v19G Gaia-corrected, flare-cleaned event for every observation
registered_inputs.blank_sky_events: the matching v19G Gaia-corrected blank-sky event for every observation
registered_inputs.point_sources: exclude the already frozen v19F 1.5-times-wavdetect ellipses from science and blank-sky events before reprojection
registered_inputs.reprojection: CIAO reproject_events with aspect=none onto the Gaia-anchored reference event; science uses random=-1 to preserve EDSER positions and TIME-less blank sky uses deterministic random=integer ObsID

image_products.exposure_map: sum of per-observation effective-area-times-exposure maps on the exact common tangent grid
image_products.blank_sky_normalization: use each frozen v19F BKGSCALn once for its matching CCD_ID; do not rescale event rows or apply a second area factor
image_products.scaled_background_counts: sum over observation and CCD of BKGSCALn times raw blank-sky counts
image_products.background_variance: sum over observation and CCD of BKGSCALn squared times raw blank-sky counts
image_products.valid_pixel_mask: relative exposure at least 0.5, inside 1200 kpc, and covered by at least one science FOV after point-source exclusion

centroid.weight: positive part of background-subtracted 0.5-2.0 keV counts divided by exposure within the current 1000-kpc aperture
centroid.initialization: the frozen component-wise median RA_NOM and DEC_NOM used by v19G
centroid.failure_rule: fail rather than alter the aperture, energy band, exposure mask, or weighting

coverage_gate.failure_rule: fail the source-observability gate; never drop an observation or shrink the common physical aperture based on morphology

automated_front_estimator.input: unviewed background-subtracted 0.5-2.0 keV count and exposure arrays on the common grid
automated_front_estimator.statistic: at each physical Gaussian scale, compute the exposure-aware Poisson score for a step in surface brightness across the local gradient normal; retain scale-space nonmaximum ridges

profile_fit.model: Poisson forward fit of a projected broken-power-law emissivity density with a discontinuous compression and additive scaled blank-sky background

uncertainty.normal_covariance: circular bootstrap covariance of accepted ridge normals
uncertainty.position_covariance: full sky-plane covariance from bootstrap ridge refits

shock_classification_after_spectra.primary_front_rule: among automatically confirmed shocks, select the ridge with the greatest integrated Poisson log-likelihood improvement over no discontinuity; retain and report every other ridge

gates.failure_rule: fail identifiability; do not lower significance, hand-draw a sector, insert a published front coordinate, or choose a different ridge because it later predicts lensing better

spatial_binning.mask: the common valid-pixel mask inside 1200 kpc
spatial_binning.failure_rule: do not change S/N, smoothing, aperture, exposure cut, count cut, source-fraction cut, or geometric constraint for either cluster

galactic_absorption.source: NASA HEASARC nH v3 HI4PI interface
galactic_absorption.selection: inverse-distance weighted HI4PI average at the frozen converged X-ray centroid

spectral_extraction.unit: every observation, CCD, and frozen accepted region having at least one source-band event
spectral_extraction.empty_coverage_rule: skip only a cell with zero source-band events after frozen FOV, CCD, point-source, and region filters; record every skip before fitting

abundance_solar.regional_rule: fixed to the same cluster integrated best-fit abundance

normalization.initial_rule: max(1e-8, 0.01 times the background-unsubtracted 0.5-7.0 count rate in counts per second)

fixed: integrated abundance during regional and shock-side fits
spectral_model.optimization: levmar, then neldermead plus one levmar polish only if the first result fails or is nonfinite
spectral_model.uncertainty: Sherpa conf 68-percent profile likelihood with every other free parameter profiled
spectral_model.no_outcome_selection: retain every fitted region and never change model, band, background, or abundance because a temperature is surprising

shock_side_spectra.geometry: automatic strips parallel to the primary front on its brighter and fainter sides, excluding the bootstrap 95-percent front-position band
shock_side_spectra.failure_rule: fail shock-speed identifiability if either side cannot reach the count target without exceeding the frozen width

fit_gates.failure_rule: report failures without merging, splitting, smoothing, or selectively refitting regions

resolved_gas_uncertainty.emission_measure: derive each accepted bin emission measure and covariance from its apec normalization, response, redshift, and Planck18 angular-diameter distance
resolved_gas_uncertainty.surface_density_relation: for sampled line-of-sight depth L, Sigma_gas = mu_e m_p sqrt(EM_area * L / (n_e/n_H))

member_phase_structure.inputs: all 141 published member rows with their quoted cz uncertainties; published subcluster labels and BCG flags are retained only for post-fit validation
member_phase_structure.primary_fit: heteroscedastic Gaussian mixture in tangent-plane x, y, and rest-frame line-of-sight velocity
member_phase_structure.standardization: median and robust interquartile scale of each measured coordinate within each catalog; this is a measurement normalization, not a gravity parameter
member_phase_structure.selection: lowest BIC; require Delta-BIC at least 10 relative to the next simpler model before adding a component
member_phase_structure.velocity_error_model: convolve each component likelihood with the row's quoted cz uncertainty
member_phase_structure.failure_rule: fail the phase-identifiability gate; do not force two components, use published labels to rescue the fit, or tune a spatial bandwidth by lensing performance

BULLET.published_clock_assumption: subcluster motion is related to X-ray shock speed in a two-body interpretation

ABELL2146.published_clock_assumption: two-body dynamical model and first-core-passage interpretation

draw_rules.inclination: uniform in sin(angle) within the published source-side bounds
draw_rules.front_state: draw jointly from the bootstrap position, normal, compression, upstream temperature, and temperature-jump covariance
draw_rules.member_state: draw from the catalog-bootstrap mixture posterior including row velocity errors
draw_rules.line_of_sight_depth_factor: universal log-uniform factor from 0.5 to 2.0 relative to the local sky-plane geometric-mean extent; report this prior sensitivity separately
draw_rules.kinematic_clock: t_front = projected distance from the downstream member-component centroid to the front divided by shock speed times cos(inclination)
draw_rules.published_clock: draw uniformly across the declared published interval but keep it as a separate assumption-dependent branch
draw_rules.clock_robustness: all later source observables must be reported under the primary kinematic clock and the published-clock branch; neither branch may be selected by lensing performance

projection_clock_ensemble.output: joint draws and covariance for gas surface density, front position and normal, Mach number, shock speed, member-component phase coordinates, inclination, line-of-sight depth, and both clock branches

gates.failure_rule: fail causal-source readiness rather than narrow a prior or select a clock branch using a halo or lensing target

visual_audit_after_machine_execution.purpose: detect software or coordinate failures, chip-edge artifacts, unmasked compact sources, and nonsensical region topology
visual_audit_after_machine_execution.failure_action: record the artifact and issue a new pre-analysis implementation protocol; do not edit the scientific result in place

required: both clusters have at least one automatically confirmed shock
both member catalogs identify at least two components
both 4096-draw projection and clock ensembles pass
every source product and covariance is content-addressed
advance_gate.next_authorized_action: freeze one label-free causal source functional and its universal transfer rule before opening any replacement-cluster lensing target
not_authorized: choosing a gravity formula from these source measurements
fitting a halo size or amplitude
opening a replacement-cluster lensing coordinate or inferred halo map
claiming that causal assembly explains dark matter
